parts.note_add: Internal: 3-phase star stator into a 6-diode bridge (B) plus a 3-diode trio (L), 2-brush rotor field, Mitsubishi-type IC regulator with R (BW, IG sense) and L (WB) on a 2-pin coupler and an F test hole in the rear housing (S-001 p.10, S-002 p.5-6). Direct replacements carry OE N22118300 with Mitsubishi A2T/A3T/A5T numbers (WAI 12278N 50 A new; Pure Energy 14550 55 A reman).
1982 Technical Data (S-038 T:3) confirms the A/T starter at 2.0 kW with 4 brushes. A/T replacements: Pure Energy / Remy / TerrePower 16717, interchange N20218400(A/B) and Mitsubishi M2T50581.
Three-phase star-wound stator, leads soldered to the rectifier (S-001 p.10 internal diagram; S-002 p.5-14).
Field-coil resistance differs by manual: 5-6 ohm (1980 FSM) vs 2.0-2.6 ohm (1985 FSM); no 1982 figure found, so measure across the slip rings before judging it.

Mazda 9960-62-202 is a 6202-size ball bearing (15 x 35 x 11 mm); drive-end replacements 6202-2Z / 6202-2RS (RockAuto lists Schaeffler 62022Z, SKF 62022ZJ, National 202SS). Pressed into the front bracket under a retainer; pre-lubricated.

Slip-ring-end bearing; RockAuto's commutator-end fitment is 6201-2RS (12 x 32 x 10 mm), e.g. SKF 62012RSJ, National 201CC - confirm the size on the old bearing. A stopper spring sits in a groove on its outer race; the rear bracket must be heated to fit or remove it.
An aftermarket listing (AS-PL ARC5017) cross-references Mazda N221-24-510 exactly, which supports the -510 reading. Six 25 A main diodes plus a diode trio, 80 mm mounting centres.
Replacements crossing N221-24-520: SMP VR163, Wells 1V1083, Transpo-type IM204 (12 V, A-circuit, R-L terminals, 14.6 V set). Mitsubishi numbers MD607372 / MD607570.
SMP JX106 crosses 8173-24-522. Brushes are soldered by their pigtails; solder so the wear-limit line stands 2-3 mm out of the holder.
Carries the front bearing (under a retainer) and the rotor; separated from the stator by prying at its slots after the through bolts are out (S-045 5:2, S-002 p.5-12).

Holds the stator, rectifier, brush holder and IC regulator; the F test hole is here, about 20 mm deep near the B terminal. The rear bearing is a tight fit, so heat the bracket before removing or fitting the rotor.
The B terminal is a stud with a nut and an insulating bushing through the rear bracket; the 1980 unit also has a radio-noise suppression condenser on B (S-045 5:2, S-002 p.5-13).

SMP SS298 and Wells 1M1169 list interchange 887224736 (this part) and 175724760; both are 3-terminal (B, S, M) Mitsubishi-type switches. Washers between the switch and the front bracket set the pinion gap.
